1 · Intro

When to use it.

When someone holds more than one job, a termination reaches further than the job you manage. Terminate Employment ends the work relationship and every assignment in it, including jobs in other areas.

Check every job and talk to the other HCM before you submit.

Use this whenSomeone you need to offboard holds more than one assignment, possibly in another school or department.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Terminate Employment on a person who keeps another job stops pay for that job too.
  • Move any direct reports on the ending assignment to a new manager before it ends.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's rule for who submits when the jobs sit in different business units.

HCM Academy job aid · Offboarding

How to handle a termination when an employee has multiple assignments

Use when: Someone you need to offboard holds more than one assignment, possibly in another school or department. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. List every active assignment and find the primary one.
  2. Ask: is the person leaving all jobs or only yours?
    • Keeps a job: End Assignment on yours
    • Leaves all: Terminate Employment
  3. Coordinate with the HCM who owns the other assignment.
  4. If your job is primary and they keep another, change primary first.
  5. Submit End Assignment or Terminate Employment with the right dates.
  6. Confirm the result in Employment Info.

Watch-outs

  • Terminate Employment on a person who keeps another job stops pay for that job too.
  • Move any direct reports on the ending assignment to a new manager before it ends.
  • Open item: confirm Vanderbilt's rule for who submits when the jobs sit in different business units.
